speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will be asking your guardian about your symptoms and medical history to understand what is wrong. Please tell me if you noticed any jaundice, difficulty breathing, or changes in your feeding habits, and if so, when did they start?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Given the lack of prenatal care and immunizations, does the infant exhibit respiratory distress, grunting, or a "grunting" sound, and has the mother had any recent viral infections or been exposed to rubella? Also, have you noticed any cyanosis or poor feeding?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (patent ductus arteriosus), non-blanching blue skin macules (petechiae), cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss in a newborn with no prenatal care is pathognomonic for Congenital Rubella Syndrome.
